DisplayName.value: Kitsune Loads ~ Cats of 7 Days: Seasons

Description.value: Cats of 7 Days, all year round: Kevin the tabby keeps the real-world calendar. Christmas pictures from November, Lunar New Year from January, then spring, summer and fall, 12 widescreen scenes each (60 in all). The picture set follows the date on your PC, and the dates can be changed in Resources/seasons.txt. Mutually exclusive with the other KitsuneLoads packs ~ install one or the other.
